inicio.subtitulo: Operational summary of the registered SQL Server instances.
inicio.vacio.texto: There are no instances registered in this environment yet. Once the first one is registered, its status and alerts will show up here.
ingreso.ayuda: Sign in with Google or with email and password, always with two-factor authentication.
sin_empresa.titulo: Sign in from your company's address
sin_empresa.texto: Each company has its own sign-in address, for example acme.dominio. If you don't know it, ask your company's administrator.
error.titulo: The operation could not be completed
admin.eyebrow: Admin panel · restricted to the Administrator role
admin.subtitulo: Company users, roles and enabled environments.
usuarios.confirmar_baja: The user will not be able to sign in. They can be reactivated for 30 days; after that they are deleted. Continue?
usuarios.creado: User created. Send them this address to sign in:
conexiones.subtitulo: The company's SQL Server instances that the system manages and monitors.
conexiones.vacio: There are no connections registered yet.
conexiones.winrm_sin_servicios: WinRM connected, but no SQL Server services were found.
conexiones.confirmar_eliminar: The connection and its credentials will be deleted. The logs are kept. Continue?
conexiones.confirmar_mfa: Deleting a PROD connection requires confirming with the second factor. The Auth0 screen will open. Continue?
conexiones.form.password_conservar: Leave empty to keep the current one
conexiones.form.windows_ayuda: Optional. Lets you view and start the SQL Server service when the engine is down.
monitor.subtitulo: Real-time health and performance of the SQL Server engine. Refreshes automatically every 3 seconds. Click any instrument to see its history.
monitor.vacio.titulo: There are no instances registered yet
monitor.vacio.texto: Monitoring starts automatically when an Administrator or DBA registers a connection.
monitor.sin_datos: There are no readings for this instance yet. The collector picks it up within 30 seconds.
monitor.obsoleto: The connection to the instance was lost (CON_DB_003). Showing the last known values, from {hora}.
monitor.serie.vacia: No data in the selected range.
monitor.serie.escalas: Scale relative to the range maximum —
monitor.config.ayuda: Disabled metrics are not shown. Thresholds color the instruments and will be the basis for alerts; critical must be greater than warning. Leave both empty to not use thresholds.
alertas.evento.instancia.descripcion: Unable to connect to {servidor} (CON_DB_003). The engine may be stopped or the network down.
alertas.evento.bloqueo.titulo: Sustained blocking for more than {segundos} s
alertas.evento.bloqueo.descripcion: Session {sid} blocked by session {bloqueador} for {espera} s ({recurso}). Sessions in this situation: {cantidad}.
alertas.evento.log.descripcion: The log of {base} is at {uso}%. Check the log backups or its growth.
alertas.subtitulo: {activas} active alerts, {criticas} critical. Severities follow the thresholds configured in Monitoring and the alert rules.
alertas.sin_atendidas: There are no acknowledged alerts yet.
alertas.reglas.ayuda: Besides these rules, the Monitoring thresholds and the fixed events (instance unreachable, database unavailable, blocking for more than 30 s and transaction log above 90%) raise alerts automatically.
alertas.reglas.vacio: There are no custom rules yet.
alertas.reglas.confirmar_eliminar: The rule «{nombre}» will be deactivated and its active alerts closed. The history is kept. Continue?
alertas.push.activado: Push notifications enabled on this device.
alertas.push.desactivado: Push notifications disabled on this device.
alertas.push.denegado: The browser is not allowed to show notifications.
alertas.push.no_soportado: This browser does not support push notifications.
alertas.push.sin_service_worker: The browser did not register the service worker (requires HTTPS with a trusted certificate).
alertas.confirmar_reactivar: «{titulo}» will raise alerts again if the condition is met. Continue?
alertas.atender.desestimar_ayuda: The alert is closed and this condition will not alert again on this instance while the dismissal is in effect. It can be reactivated from the Dismissed tab.
workarounds.aviso.autorizacion: {usuario} requests to run {workaround} on {conexion} outside the maintenance window. Reason: {motivo}
workarounds.aviso.no_realizada: Could not run {workaround} for alert A-{alerta}: {error}
conexiones.form.ventana_ayuda: Optional. Instance local time range in which heavy tasks (index rebuilds, statistics) are allowed without requesting authorization. It can span midnight.
workarounds.subtitulo: {cantidad} workarounds. Built-in ones are ready to use; custom ones are validated in the Sandbox before being enabled for PROD. Only Administrators and DBAs can create or modify them.
workarounds.vacio: There are no workarounds for the selected filter.
workarounds.confirmar_eliminar: «{nombre}» will be deactivated. Its versions and executions are kept. Continue?
workarounds.detalle.pendiente_sandbox: The current version has not been validated in the Sandbox yet: it can run on DEV and TESTING; on PROD only the latest validated version runs.
workarounds.form.transaccional: Transactional: if a step fails, all of them are rolled back (uncheck if it uses KILL, SHRINK, BACKUP or other commands that do not support transactions).
workarounds.form.pasos: Steps (one T-SQL batch per step, run in order)
workarounds.form.ayuda_validacion: Before saving, the syntax is validated by compiling the steps (without running them) against an instance and database.
workarounds.ejecutar.sin_bloqueadores: No sessions are blocking others right now.
workarounds.ejecutar.raiz: ★ heads a blocking chain. Choose the sessions to terminate.
workarounds.ejecutar.aviso_backup_log: The log is waiting for a log backup: the shrink will free little until one is taken.
workarounds.ejecutar.sin_bases_caidas: All databases on the instance are ONLINE.
workarounds.ejecutar.base_no_recuperable: Only OFFLINE databases are brought ONLINE. SUSPECT, RECOVERY_PENDING or EMERGENCY need manual diagnosis (files, DBCC CHECKDB): forcing them can lose data.
workarounds.ejecutar.nada: There is nothing to do right now.
workarounds.ejecutar.ayuda_autorizacion: Outside the maintenance window, authorization from another Administrator or DBA is required. Once authorized, you have 2 hours to run it.
workarounds.ejecutar.autorizacion_pedida: Authorization requested. Administrators and DBAs have been notified.
workarounds.ejecutar.confirmar_mfa: Running on PROD requires confirming with the second factor. The Auth0 screen will open. Continue?
workarounds.autorizaciones.ayuda: Requests to run heavy tasks outside the maintenance window. They are authorized by another Administrator or DBA; the request expires after 24 h and the authorization after 2 h.
workarounds.automatizaciones.ayuda: Built-in workarounds that run on their own when the event's alert is triggered. Each execution is audited and Administrators and DBAs are notified. Configuring it for PROD (or for all connections) requires the second factor.
sandbox.subtitulo: Test queries and scripts against a copy of the structure of {instancia} in a Docker container, with no data and no risk: everything is rolled back when it finishes.
sandbox.editor.eyebrow: T-SQL editor · batches separated by GO
sandbox.editor.placeholder: Type or paste the T-SQL to validate
sandbox.sintaxis_ok: Valid syntax: the batches compile against the Sandbox structure.
sandbox.aviso_estructura: Warning SBX_SNP_000: the Sandbox structure is more than 24 hours old or does not match the source. You should sync it.
sandbox.promover_nota: Administrator and DBA · requires second factor on PROD
sandbox.muestra.vacia: No rows: the Sandbox only has the structure, no data.
sandbox.historial.vacio: There are no Sandbox executions yet.
sandbox.promocion.analizando: Calculating the estimated plan on the real instance…
sandbox.promocion.ayuda: It runs on the real database inside a transaction: if anything fails, it is rolled back. It is recorded in the transactions audit log and Administrators and DBAs are notified.
sandbox.promocion.confirmar: Confirm and run on the instance
sandbox.promocion.confirmar_mfa: Promoting to PROD requires confirming with the second factor. The Auth0 screen will open. Continue?
sandbox.aviso.exitosa: {usuario} promoted a Sandbox-validated script on {base}: {filas} rows affected.
sandbox.aviso.fallida: The promotion by {usuario} on {base} failed and was rolled back: {error}
workarounds.validar.ayuda: Runs the steps of the current version in the Sandbox (against the instance structure, with no data and rolling back at the end). If it passes, that version is approved for PROD; if it fails, the previously approved version remains in effect.
workarounds.validar.ok: Validated in Sandbox: the current version is now approved for PROD.
workarounds.validar.sin_bases: This instance's Sandbox has no synced databases yet: sync it from Sandbox.
chat.subtitulo: Write in plain language. I'll take care of the T-SQL and of choosing where to run it.
chat.sin_conexiones: You have no enabled instances: ask an Administrator to enable the environment for you or to register a connection.
chat.confirmar_eliminar: Delete this conversation? Whatever was executed stays recorded in the log.
chat.vacio: Tell me what you need to know. For example: «how many orders were canceled last month by branch?»
chat.requiere_mfa: Running it requires confirming with the second factor.
chat.placeholder: Write your query in plain language, for example: «how many orders were canceled last month by branch?»
chat.elige_base: The system chooses the database automatically
chat.columnas_enmascaradas: 🔒 Sensitive columns masked for your role (also in the CSV).
chat.sandbox_ok: Validated in Sandbox: {filas} rows in {ms} ms (rolled back). Promote it from there.
chat.confirmar_mfa: This operation requires confirming with the second factor. Continue?
chat.confirmar_advertencias: The operation breaks these business rules. Run it anyway?
chat.mod.INSERT_CONSULTA: I'm going to insert into {tabla} the records returned by a query.
chat.mod.estimado: Count calculated with the current data: it may change until you confirm.
chat.motivo.sandbox: This type of statement does not run directly: validate it in the Sandbox and promote it from there.
chat.motivo.solo_lectura: Your role can only run read queries.
chat.motivo.falta_where: Modifications need a WHERE that limits the rows.
chat.motivo.tabla_restringida: Your role does not have access to one of the sensitive tables involved.
chat.motivo.regla: A business rule blocks this operation.
contexto.subtitulo: The AI engine uses this context to translate your queries accurately within the business domain. {tablas} tables in the database, {terminos} terms, {reglas} rules.
contexto.sin_conexiones: There are no connections registered yet.
contexto.sensibles.eyebrow: Tables with access rules · double confirmation / masking
contexto.form.roles_ven: Roles that see the columns unmasked
contexto.form.doble_confirmacion: Double confirmation (second factor) to modify it
contexto.form.regla_ejemplo: Do not modify data in PROD outside business hours
contexto.form.franja_ayuda: Local time of each connection. With no time range it always applies; a range that spans midnight (18:00 to 09:00) covers outside business hours.
contexto.confirmar_eliminar: Delete this item from the context?
sandbox.promocion.mfa: Requires confirming with the second factor.
inicio.alertas_pendientes: There are {n} active alerts that require your attention.
inicio.promociones: {n} queries validated in Sandbox are pending promotion.
inicio.accion.chat.descripcion: AI Chat · Plain language → executable T-SQL
inicio.accion.workarounds.descripcion: Release blocking sessions · Log shrink · Clear plan cache
inicio.accion.sandbox.descripcion: Isolated execution in Docker before touching production
auditoria.subtitulo: Tamper-proof record of every action executed in the system. Filterable and exportable to CSV or PDF for regulators.
auditoria.vacio: No records for the selected filters.
auditoria.limite: There are {registros} records and this format's limit is {limite}: narrow the filters.
schema.subtitulo: {n} versions recorded · one for each structure change executed from the application. Diff and comparison between versions.
schema.sin_conexiones: There are no connections registered yet.
schema.ayuda_comparar: Choose one version to compare it with the current state, or two to compare them with each other.
schema.vacio: There are no structure changes recorded in this database.
schema.sin_diff_detalle: The structure could not be read before or after the execution: the DDL is recorded, without a diff.
bp.subtitulo: The system measures the database (queries, indexes, fragmentation and schema) and the AI engine proposes improvements with their T-SQL. Every suggestion is validated in the Sandbox before being applied.
bp.sin_conexiones: You have no enabled instances: ask an Administrator to enable the environment for you or to register a connection.
bp.nuevo.titulo: What do you want to review?
bp.tipo_ayuda.consultas: The most CPU-expensive queries in the database (sys.dm_exec_query_stats).
bp.tipo_ayuda.indices: Missing indexes detected by the optimizer.
bp.tipo_ayuda.fragmentacion: Fragmented indexes larger than 1,000 pages (lightweight scan).
bp.tipo_ayuda.esquema: Tables without a primary key, heaps, unindexed foreign keys and deprecated types.
bp.reglas.eyebrow: Team rules · checked by the AI engine
bp.reglas.ejemplo: Every table must have audit columns (created_at, created_by)
bp.informe.en_curso: Measuring the database and analyzing the findings… this may take a minute.
bp.sandbox_ok: Validated in the Sandbox (rolled back). It is applied when promoted.
bp.error.ia: Communication error with the AI engine (IA_API_000). The measured data was saved.
error.USR_VAL_006: The user was recently deactivated; they can be reactivated.
error.USR_AUT_001: The second authentication factor is invalid or was not completed.
error.USR_AUT_005: The session expired or does not exist.
error.USR_AUT_003: The email has not been verified yet.
error.USR_AUT_004: The sign-in request expired or is invalid.
error.USR_PER_000: The role does not have permission for this action.
error.USR_PER_003: The permissions exceed those of the base role.
error.USR_PER_004: An Administrator cannot remove their own role or deactivate themselves.
error.USR_PER_005: At least one active Administrator must remain.
error.CON_DB_000: Could not connect to the instance.
error.CON_DB_001: A connection with that alias already exists.
error.CON_DB_003: The connection to the instance was lost.
error.MNT_CFG_000: The critical threshold must be greater than the warning threshold.
error.ALR_VAL_001: An alert with that name already exists.
error.ALR_VAL_002: The alert has already been acknowledged.
error.WKR_VAL_001: A workaround with that name already exists.
error.WKR_EJE_000: One of the workaround steps failed.
error.WKR_EJE_001: The situation changed since the diagnosis; review it and confirm again.
error.WKR_SBX_001: The workaround is not validated in Sandbox; it cannot run on PROD.
error.WKR_AMB_000: The workaround does not apply to that environment.
error.WKR_VEN_000: Outside the maintenance window: requires authorization from another user.
error.WKR_AUT_001: You cannot authorize your own request.
error.WKR_AUT_002: Only eligible built-in workarounds can run automatically.
error.SBX_SNP_000: The Sandbox structure is more than 24 hours old or does not match the source.
error.SBX_SNP_001: The Sandbox does not have that database yet: sync it and try again.
error.SBX_PRM_000: Only a successful execution that has not been promoted can be promoted.
error.SQL_VAL_001: This type of statement does not run directly: validate it in the Sandbox and promote it.
error.SQL_VAL_002: UPDATE, DELETE and INSERT…SELECT require a WHERE.
error.SQL_LCK_000: There are open transactions or locks on the tables involved; try again later.
error.EXP_LIM_000: The volume exceeds the export limit: narrow the filters.
error.BPR_VAL_000: Report, suggestion or rule not found.
error.BPR_VAL_001: The suggestion has no T-SQL to apply.
error.IA_API_000: Communication error with the AI engine.
error.IA_TRA_000: The query could not be translated.
error.CTX_VAL_001: The operation involves a sensitive table: it requires confirming with the second factor.
error.CTX_VAL_003: Technical entity not found in the schema.
error.CTX_REG_000: A business rule blocks the operation.
error.CTX_REG_001: The operation breaks warning-level business rules: confirm to continue.
error.WRM_000: Could not connect to the Windows server (WinRM).
error.AMB_VAL_000: The operation on PROD requires confirming with the second factor.
error.TEN_VAL_002: The tenant identifier is not valid.
workarounds.integrado.kill_bloqueos.desc: Lists the sessions that block others and terminates the selected ones with KILL.
workarounds.integrado.shrink_log.descrip: Runs CHECKPOINT and shrinks the database log to the space in use plus a margin.
workarounds.integrado.rebuild_indices.de: REBUILD of indexes with fragmentation above 30% and at least 1000 pages.
UPDATE STATISTICS on statistics with more than 20% of rows modified.
workarounds.integrado.limpiar_plan_cache: Removes the cached plans of the selected database (does not affect the others).
workarounds.integrado.checkpoint.descrip: Runs CHECKPOINT on the selected database to write modified pages to disk.
workarounds.integrado.iniciar_servicio.d: Starts the engine service on the Windows server through WinRM when it is stopped.
workarounds.integrado.base_online.descri: Lists the databases that are unavailable and sets the selected one ONLINE, if it is OFFLINE.
bp.hallazgo.indice_faltante: Missing index suggested by the optimizer
bp.hallazgo.sin_pk_ni_clustered: Table without a primary key or clustered index
bp.hallazgo.heap: Heap table: the primary key is not clustered
bp.hallazgo.fk_sin_indice: Foreign key {fk} without an index on {columna}
app.descripcion: Assistant for SQL Server administration and optimization.
